01 The Firm

41 Years. 31 Running His Own.

41 years in this industry. 31 years running his own firm. Not as a vendor. Not as a consultant-for-hire. As a practitioner with real clients, real decisions, and real consequences — watching what actually moves the needle, and what doesn't.

02 The Faculty

Teaching Isn't a Credential. It's a Forcing Function.

For 22 of those years — simultaneously, not sequentially — on faculty at the University of South Carolina's journalism school. Advertising campaign strategy. Creative strategy. Writing for public relations.

When you have to explain why something works to a room that will push back, you develop a different relationship with the craft than someone who just executes it. You can't fake your way through 22 years of that.

03 The Files

Not Case Studies. The Originals.

24 years of actual client files. Not reconstructions written after the fact. The original documents — strategy briefs, media plans, creative direction, and the email threads where the real decisions got made and the real problems surfaced.

04 The Machine

All of It. Processed.

Every file processed by AI. Cross-referenced against current consumer behavior data. Validated against performance benchmarks across 17 home service verticals. Pattern-matched against 2,401 diagnosed businesses.

The result is a diagnostic system no competitor can replicate. Not with funding. Not with talent. Not with time. Because it required all three — plus 41 years of not throwing anything away.
